title: Model Fund I PPM (excerpt)
summary: PPM for Model Fund I: $100M target, 1.5% fee, 9% pref, small-bay industrial and flex in the West and Southwest, 35% state limit.

evidence.quote: This Private Placement Memorandum describes an offering of interests in Model Fund I, L.P.
The Partnership is targeting Aggregate Commitments of $100,000,000.
Limited Partners will pay a Management Fee of 1.5% per year.
The Preferred Return is 9% per year.

limits.label: Single state, % of gross asset value

evidence.quote: The Partnership will not invest more than 35% of its gross asset value in any one state.
